messages:
Priya: Quick sync — Kestrel cohort B onboarding needs a 90m clinic next week. Customer prefers APAC-friendly window; also flagged as a potential renewal risk (low API usage). Can we plan host + 1 backup and a short health-check agenda?
Noah: I can host but prefer a later APAC slot. Thu 09:00 UTC (18:00 SGT) works for me.
Elena: Thu 09:00 UTC ok from CS side. Priya, is customer available then?
Priya: Yes, they confirmed 18:00 SGT. We should include a 15m health check at the top: usage, blockers, success metrics, renewal concerns.
Devon: I'll be backup. I'll prepare a 10-slide runbook + sample prompts. Putting draft in the folder: https://drive.redwood.com/kestrel/onboard-pack
Noah: Cool — can we also add an NPS + 3-question pulse survey at the end? Quick capture helps the renewal thread. Something like:
```
1) Rate onboarding helpfulness (1-5)
2) Biggest blocker now (free text)
3) Likelihood to renew (1-5)
```
Elena: +1. Also add an opt-in for a follow-up 1:1. I'll wire the survey into the calendar invite and set reminder 10m before end.
Priya: Ops checklist: host, backup, recording on, share deck, survey link, triage doc for post-session action items. Who owns the triage doc?
Devon: I'll own triage doc during the session. Afterward I'll tag owners and send summary in the account thread.
cs-bot: Reminder queued — calendar invite draft will be posted in #customer-success in 10m. Use `@cs-bot create invite Thu 2024-11-14 09:00 UTC Kestrel Onboarding Clinic`
Noah: One more ask — can we enable auto-captioning and save recording to the Kestrel folder? Some stakeholders rely on captions.
Elena: Noted. Priya, I'll add caption request to the invite and confirm storage retention settings (30 days default, we can extend).
Priya: Perfect. Post-session plan: 1) summarize action items, 2) send pulse survey, 3) schedule 1:1 if NPS <=3 or renewal risk flagged. Devon will run triage.
Noah: I'll paste a short agenda into the invite: Intro (5m), Health check (15m), Walkthrough (45m), Q&A (20m), Survey + next steps (5m).
Devon: Uploaded draft deck v1 to drive. Will iterate on any technical asks in the thread.
Elena: Thanks all — assigning hosts: Noah (host), Devon (backup), Priya (CS lead). I'll mark in the facilitator rota. :white_check_mark:
Priya: Thanks — leaving action items: Devon create triage doc, Noah finalize invite, Elena configure survey+captions, me to prep renewal-risk notes. See you on Thu. :thumbsup:
